verdict.rationale: Deepgram's documented endpoints carry an explicit version segment in the path (e.g. /v1/listen, /v1/agent/converse), which suggests a versioned API. Nothing in the pack describes a versioning policy, deprecation timelines, sunset notices or a changelog. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, a documented API versioning/compatibility policy, deprecation notice or migration guidance, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
